newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books to build new plant.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books to build new plant.

text.p: Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc said on Wednesday it will begin construction of its new manufacturing and administrative office facilities in Sturtevant, Wisconsin.
The facilities are located within 10 miles of its existing facilities in Racine, Wisconsin, Golden Books said.

Golden Books will construct a 408,000 square foot manufacturing building and an adjacent 58,300 square foot office building, which will replace its facilities in Racine, the company said in a statement.

The manufacturing building, which will house the company's printing and bindery operations, is scheduled for completion in February 1998. The administrative office building is scheduled for completion in April 1998.

Golden Books decided in December to continue manufacturing its core Golden Books products there after it reached an agreement with its five unions, the State of Wisconsin, and local governments, the company said.

The decision was predicated on a package of financial Vincentives worth approximately $5 million, including tax credits and low-cost financing, as well as wage and benefit concessions and work rule changes, Golden Books said.
